column2: world's first governance framework built specifically for agentic AI
column5: The one instrument worldwide addressing agent autonomy bounds, action logging, human-in-the-loop and multi-agent accountability — the four axes every compose/patterns.md recipe must defend. Deleted by p315's rewrite, unnoticed ~179 passes.

The assurance half of the Singapore programme. A voluntary instrument that functions as a PROCUREMENT GATE for vendors selling to banks and government — the reason SG-AGENTIC-FIRST is a sales asset and not a compliance burden.

Vietnam's Decision 33 makes a RAG tutor over an unvetted corpus high-risk on the retrieval design alone, with no grading feature anywhere in the product. An EU-conformant design has no corpus-provenance artefact to show for it.

The education/health/finance deadline for systems already in operation before 15 Aug 2026. p493 degraded this precise holding into an apparent contradiction; p494 restored it. The conditional is the whole value.
The 16-month slip of the EU high-risk deadline for stand-alone education systems. The entire EMEA engagement window argument rests on this date.
The High-severity sandbox escape in execute_typescript. One of two High advisories on the base of P490-1.
The Node.js floor the v1.16.0 sandbox fix REQUIRES. Deploy P490-1 on an older Node and the patched release is not actually patched.
The diagnosis that separates a proxy allowlist refusal from a transient outage. Without it, every pass re-probes arxiv.org and eur-lex.europa.eu and re-files them as "might be cleared next time".
Closes a standing action carried 10+ passes. The Omnibus primary read is a HUMAN deliverable, not a pass backlog item.
The longest-standing declared gap in this KB — 13 passes. An informed gap is information; deleting it looks exactly like coverage.
The LATAM demand-side evidence. Verified passes ago and found ABSENT from intel/market.md at p495 — the second instance of p494's prose-loss defect, and the first found on purpose.

UNESCO IESALC adoption by function. Administration at 34.1% against teaching/learning at 73.5% is where the open ERP/SIS layer sells; without the split there is no argument for the administration engagement.
~30% institutional policy coverage against ~92% student engagement. This contrast IS the LATAM pitch: the bottleneck is governance, not adoption or capability.
A declared gap that three patterns choose their base on. p494 established that a deleted gap is indistinguishable from coverage.
